main_feature_claims: Realistic electrical shock simulation with arc sparks

how_to_use_flow: Step 1: Choose a stun gun weapon skin or hair clipper prank mode.
Step 2: Tap the stun gun image on screen or press the virtual trigger.
Step 3: Watch the camera flash strobe, feel the vibration, and hear the shock sounds to scare your friends.
